searchText: have any execution clients dropped support for pre-1559 transaction types? do you mean "dropped" as in don't accept over RPC? i guess I mean it in the broadest sense... i'm looking for minimization of supporting both transaction types. i *assume* nobody is denying them from their transaction pools all tx types are still valid in blocks so you'll need to support them to validate them in blocks so I guess the RPC call is really the only opportunity for pre-London cleanup. fwiw, type 0 transactions are still used a fair bit, but type 1 (pre-1559 access list) have almost no usage i mean, we could make it invalid in a future fork, but you'd need to maintain the logic in client if you want to still i) full sync or ii) retrieve the historical txs via rpc
